title: Happy mouse
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- happy mouse, bright simple shapes -->
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='30' r='16' fill='#f2a6b8'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='30' r='16' fill='#f2a6b8'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='30' r='9' fill='#ffd0da'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='30' r='9' fill='#ffd0da'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='70' rx='28' ry='24' fill='#9fb8e8'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='74' rx='16' ry='14' fill='#d6e4ff'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='42' r='22' fill='#9fb8e8'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='13' ry='10' fill='#d6e4ff'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='48' r='5' fill='#ff9db4'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='48' r='5' fill='#ff9db4'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='38' r='4' fill='#2a2a6a'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='38' r='4' fill='#2a2a6a'/>
  <circle cx='42.5' cy='36.5' r='1.4' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='60.5' cy='36.5' r='1.4' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='47' r='3.2' fill='#ff6f91'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M44 52 Q50 58 56 52' stroke='#3a3a7a' stroke-width='2.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- whiskers -->
  <path d='M37 49 L24 46' stroke='#c8d6f5' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M37 52 L23 53' stroke='#c8d6f5' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M63 49 L76 46' stroke='#c8d6f5' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M63 52 L77 53' stroke='#c8d6f5' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- arms -->
  <circle cx='24' cy='68' r='6' fill='#9fb8e8'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='68' r='6' fill='#9fb8e8'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='92' rx='9' ry='5' fill='#ff9db4'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='92' rx='9' ry='5' fill='#ff9db4'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M74 84 Q90 80 86 66' stroke='#f2a6b8' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
